scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && env -u NODE_ENV npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace apps/api && npm run check --workspace apps/web && npm run check --workspace packages/types
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
